features: entry fee pot per room (any ERC20 or free entry)
creator payoutWallet + creatorShareBps — pot share routes to the creator's chosen wallet
creator locks a reward (ERC20 tokens or an ERC721 NFT); the contract holds it until settlement
settlement signed by authority; Mode.Auto pushes pot shares + rewards to winners instantly, Mode.Manual = pull-based claim with an authority signature
creator reclaims unclaimed rewards after the claim deadline
treasury sweepDust — only uncommitted surplus; pots and locked rewards are tracked via tokenCommitted and can never be swept
gamePot.note: CenterGamePot v1 — per-room entry fees and locked rewards. The DepositVault (0x33e0...0aa3) stays the creator deposit path; the pot handles room entry fees and rewards. Treasury = admin 9087e wallet: receives sweepable dust and protocol rake (feeBps, currently 0), never player entries.
